excerpt: Can You Stay in Canada While Waiting for H&C Decision? Legal Facts Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Canada’s immigration process can be complex, and many applicants turn to consultants or representatives for help. Unfortunately, some fall into the trap of ghost consultants, unlicensed individuals who offer immigration services illegally. If you have been misled, overcharged, or defrauded by someone claiming to be an immigration consultant, you are not alone. Ghost consultant fraud is a growing concern, and understanding what to do next can help you protect your immigration
author: Anuj Sengar
